memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Kara kept the Amelia Shoreline Friday-Monday booking despite the gated overflow self-parking caveat, accepted that the mandatory resort fee still applies in poor weather, chose a weather-flexible Saturday bike rental with a Friday forecast check, and set an 8:30 a.m. Tampa departure with a Sadler Road Publix stop and low-key rain backups.

messages.content: Can you do the Amelia check now? I don’t want to reopen lodging unless the parking change or the forecast makes Friday–Monday a bad call.

I reconfirmed Amelia Shoreline, ASR-48172: refundable queen coastal-view room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, pool, hot tub, and fitness center. Caveats: the mandatory resort fee still applies even if weather limits beach time; self-parking is now in a gated overflow lot during the lobby work, with signs/shuttle help but less convenient unloading; early check-in is not guaranteed.
Overflow lot is annoying, but not worth switching. Does the full three nights still make sense if Saturday turns wet?

I’d keep Friday–Monday. It buys you a Sunday weather swap for biking/beach time and keeps the Monday drive calm. Dropping Sunday night saves money, but it turns Saturday into the make-or-break day and doesn’t avoid the resort fee on the nights you keep.
Keep it. For bikes, I don’t want to be stuck paying if the forecast gets ugly.

Best practical plan: reserve two hybrid bikes for Saturday late morning with Island Cycles’ 24-hour cancellation, then review Friday morning. If it’s wind only, do a shorter Fort Clinch/greenway loop. If it’s steady rain, cancel or ask to move to Sunday. Same-day resort rentals are lower commitment but may be gone if the weather clears.
Do that, and make the route shorter by default unless the weather looks really clean.

Done. I set the bike plan for Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m., cancellable until Friday at 10 a.m., with a Friday forecast check. Notes: bring your own helmets/lights if you want familiar gear; rental locks are included; switch to Sunday only if the shop confirms availability.
What leave time from Tampa still works with groceries but avoids us hovering before check-in?

Leave Tampa around 8:30 a.m. Friday. With lunch and buffer, hit the Publix on Sadler Road about 1:45–2:15 for drinks, snacks, and breakfast basics, then aim for resort arrival around 3:30. If you’re ahead, use historic Fernandina for coffee/walk time instead of pushing early check-in. I added backups: Amelia Island Museum, downtown café/bookstore, Fort Clinch only in light rain, fitness/hot tub time, and an easy dinner plan. Friday–Monday stays booked; overflow parking and non-waived resort fee are flagged.
